items.title: Abhijeet Dipke's new personal post: Modi 'a fascist dictator'
items.summary: New top post on @abhijeetdipke (~66K likes, ~780 comments within minutes): 'Waging war against your own countrymen. You’re showing the country exactly what you are: a fascist dictator, @narendramodi.' First direct public statement from the founder since reaching Hingoli for his grandmother's last rites — a personal-rhetoric escalation while Das and Ranka lead from Delhi. Provider returned no post timestamp; ranked newest at the ~3:10 PM IST fetch and absent from the 2:47 PM IST check.
